title: Go BFF Security & Auth Middleware (JWT ED25519 & Redis Rate-Limit)
lead: Membangun middleware autentikasi backend Go Gin untuk verifikasi asymmetric JWT ED25519, proteksi brute-force login via Redis memory bucket, dan injeksi context tenant_id ke seluruh HTTP handler.
flowDesc: HTTP Request masuk -> Middleware Rate Limit cek IP -> Middleware Auth verifikasi signature JWT -> Inject tenant_id ke Gin Context -> Teruskan ke Controller.
flowDiagram:
[ Incoming HTTP Request ]
       │
       ▼
[ RateLimitMiddleware (5 req/detik) ]
       │ PASS
       ▼
[ JWTAuthMiddleware (Asymmetric Verify) ]
       │ Valid Token
       ▼
[ c.Set("tenant_id", claims.TenantID) ]
       │
       ▼
[ Business Handler (Controller) ]

Arsitektur Security: Middleware asymmetric JWT ED25519 & header Authorization bearer

Integrasi Real Backend: Injeksi context tenant_id ke database PostgreSQL RLS

title: Traefik Dynamic Custom Domain & Let's Encrypt TLS Automation
lead: Mengonfigurasi Traefik v3 agar dapat memetakan custom domain tenant secara otomatis dengan penerbitan sertifikat SSL Let's Encrypt instan tanpa restart proxy.
flowDesc: Pengunjung mengakses custom domain -> Traefik mencocokkan resolver ACME -> Validasi challenge HTTP-01 -> Terbitkan SSL -> Forward traffic ke kontainer tenant.
flowDiagram:
[ Pengunjung Web ]
       │  (HTTPS custom domain)
       ▼
[ Traefik v3 Edge Ingress (:443) ]
       │  Dynamic Config Watcher
       ├── 1. Cek Sertifikat SSL Let's Encrypt (Automated Renewal)
       ├── 2. Apply Middleware: Security Headers & Rate Limit
       ▼
[ Kontainer Tenant Isolated (hero_tenant_xxx) ]

checklist.text: Pembenahan Tampilan UI: Indikator status SSL (Active, Pending, Failed) di CustomDomainsModule
Arsitektur Ingress: Konfigurasi dynamic file provider Traefik dan ACME certResolver
Audit Keamanan: Validasi nama domain anti-injection router rules
Integrasi Real Ingress: Penerbitan sertifikat SSL produksi Let's Encrypt via HTTP-01
Integrasi Real Ingress: Automatic SSL renewal background timer dengan zero downtime

codeSnippet:
http:
  routers:
    tenant-custom-domain:
      rule: "Host(`kedaikopi.com`)"
      entryPoints:
        - websecure
      service: tenant-hero-9942
      tls:
        certResolver: letsencrypt
  services:
    tenant-hero-9942:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: "http://172.28.0.42:80"
aiNotes: Dikerjakan oleh Rizal: Konfigurasi volume acme.json 600 dan dynamic provider siap. Integrasi proses live challenge siap diuji pada domain nyata.

title: Traefik Host Rule Injection Pentest (CWE-20/CWE-93)
lead:
Memastikan input domain pada modul custom domain tidak dapat disusupi karakter newline (, 
) atau backtick (`) yang berpotensi memanipulasi rule router Traefik.
flowDesc: Input Domain -> Validasi Regex Domain RFC 1035 -> Sanitasi Karakter Khusus -> Injeksi ke dynamic Traefik YAML.
flowDiagram:
[ Input: "evil.com` || Host(`admin.herocms.id`)" ]
       │
       ▼
[ Regex Sanitizer: ^([a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\.)+[a-z]{2,}$ ]
       │
       ├── MATCH GAGAL ──▶ Reject 400 "Invalid domain format"
       └── MATCH SUKSES ──▶ Write to Traefik Config

checklist.text: Pembenahan Sanitasi: Regex domain validasi ketat ^([a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\.)+[a-z]{2,}$
Security Gate: Uji coba injeksi CRLF dan router rule escape berhasil ditolak 100%

#!/bin/bash
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
BACKUP_FILE="/backups/herocms_$TIMESTAMP.sql.gz"
pg_dump -U herocms herocms_db | gzip > "$BACKUP_FILE"
find /backups -type f -mtime +30 -name "*.sql.gz" -delete

lead: Audit kualitas keamanan berkala pada seluruh rute API, proteksi Traefik injection, cgroups resource abuse, JWT forgery, serta mitigasi OWASP Top 10 sebelum rilis produksi.
flowDesc: Trigger Pre-Commit -> Jalankan Suite Pentest Per-Service -> Deteksi Kerentanan HTTP -> Blokir Commit jika Gagal -> Izinkan Rilis jika Lolos

codeSnippet:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Paijo QC Pentest Gatekeeper
SERVICES=('02-dashboard-cms' '03-provision-orchestrator' '04-marketing-site')
for svc in "${SERVICES[@]}"; do
  (cd "services/$svc" && go test -v ./pentest/...) || exit 1
done
echo 'All Security Gates Passed!'

title: Selective Quality Gate CI/CD & Automated GitHub Incident Triage
lead: Membangun pipeline CI/CD selektif berbasis dorny/paths-filter@v3 yang hanya menguji service yang bergerak, serta pelaporan insiden otomatis ke GitHub Issues via actions/github-script@v7 jika terjadi kegagalan.
flowDesc: Git Push ke branch kerja -> Deteksi path termodifikasi -> Matriks runner dinamis (Go Vet, Pentest, Vite Build) -> Lolos: Hijau -> Gagal: Terbitkan GitHub Issue otomatis dengan tail log & runbook lokal.
flowDiagram:
[ Git Push ke feat branch ]
       │
       ▼
[ 1. Deteksi Path: dorny/paths-filter@v3 ]
       │
       ▼
[ 2. Matriks Paralel: verify-service ]
       │ (go vet + pentest + vite build)
       ├── FAIL ──▶ 🚨 Dispatch GitHub Issue Otomatis (actions/github-script@v7)
       └── PASS ──▶ ✅ CI Hijau (1m 46s) ──▶ Siap Merge ke main

checklist.text: Deteksi path selektif monorepo dengan dorny/paths-filter@v3 (s02, s03, s04, s05, s07)
Parallel quality gate runner (go vet, pentest suite, npm install, vite build)
Skrip pra-commit lokal scripts/test-changed.sh untuk pengembang
Integrasi incident dispatcher via actions/github-script@v7 dengan smart deduplication
Uji coba live dan verifikasi terbitnya tiket insiden otomatis di GitHub Issues (#27, #28)
Dokumentasi SOP-CICD-01 dan Blueprint BP-CICD-01 di Mission Control Hub

codeSnippet:
name: Aether Core CI Quality Gate
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:

  verify-service:
    needs: detect-changes
